_about: The hand-defined hierarchies of the two demo sources, in source terms, as the packs' loaders.<entity>.scope define them: walk levels are those in store.combo_key, narrow the ones after. Each level is named by its id, TABLE.COLUMN (the table its values are kept in), so a column of the same name on another table is not taken for it. selected_narrow are narrowing levels the first proposal must select. Read by tests/test_accelerator_proposer.py and test_accelerator_recovery.py; source names live here, never in sdg/accelerator.
